_note: The speaking cast. A greeting and its reply are two people; a dialogue is three or four — one voice reading every part is what makes synthesized conversation sound fake. Voice ids are PUBLIC identifiers (useless without the API key), so this file is committed like the pin in pipeline/voice.py.
_howto: Run `python3 pipeline/voices.py` to see how these resolve, or `--list` (with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set) to print your whole library. Clips are cached by filename: change a role AFTER generating and the existing clips keep the old voice until you delete them.
_gender: Dialogue speakers are cast by gender where the name gives it away (إم / ست / بنات and known names). Two male and two female voices means a woman's lines are never read by a man.
